description: This file implements the SharedMemoryBuffer class, which manages shared memory buffers for media playback, including creation, mapping, unmapping, clearing data, and accessing buffer details. It also includes factory methods for creating instances and handles different media types like generic and web audio.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBuffer
classes.description: Manages shared memory buffers for media data, including creation, mapping, unmapping, clearing, and access to buffer data.

methods.name: calculatePartitionSize
methods.description: Calculates partition sizes based on media playback type and number of partitions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts MediaPlaybackType enum to string representation.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory instance for SharedMemoryBuffer objects.

methods.name: createSharedMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Creates a SharedMemoryBuffer instance with specified number of playbacks and web audio players.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes shared memory buffer, allocates memory, and sets up partitions.

methods.name: ~SharedMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Destructor that unmaps and closes shared memory buffer.

methods.name: mapPartition
methods.description: Maps a partition for a given media playback type and ID.

methods.name: unmapPartition
methods.description: Unmaps a partition for a given media playback type and ID.

methods.name: clearData
methods.description: Clears data in a specified partition for a media source type.

methods.name: getDataOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of data for a specific partition.

methods.name: getMaxDataLen
methods.description: Returns the maximum data length for a specific partition.

methods.name: getDataPtr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data buffer for a specific partition.

methods.name: getFd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the start of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: calculateBufferSize
methods.description: Calculates total buffer size based on partitions.

methods.name: getDataPtrForPartition
methods.description: Retrieves data pointer for a specific partition based on media playback type and ID.

methods.name: getPlaybackTypePartition
methods.description: Returns the vector of partitions for a given media playback type.

calls: mmap(nullptr, size, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, fd, 0)
